hero.note: NDECOR is a Wabi-Sabi & Japandi design studio based in Dong Nai. We build spaces from reclaimed wood, raw concrete and bamboo — where every crack has a reason to exist.

studio.statement: Minimalism is erasing everything unnecessary — leaving only the essence of wood, stone and mist.
studio.philText: We don't build websites. We craft living spaces — where raw concrete keeps handprints, reclaimed wood holds its old grain, bamboo bends like the mountains. Wabi-Sabi meets Japandi, Dong Nai mist meets Northwest wind.
